summary: This bill amends the National Voter Registration Act to require anyone registering to vote in federal elections to provide specific documentary proof of U.S. citizenship, such as a REAL ID-compliant ID, passport, birth certificate, or naturalization certificate, and mandates states to verify citizenship using federal databases and remove non-citizens from voter rolls.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on federal election registration requirements, specifically mandating documentary proof of U.S. citizenship. It aims to secure elections by ensuring only citizens vote, which aligns with the +1 end of the spectrum for this topic.
